scripts.android: ANDROID_HOME=${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Library/Android/sdk} PATH="$PATH:${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Library/Android/sdk}/platform-tools" sh -c '(while kill -0 $$ 2>/dev/null; do adb reverse tcp:8081 tcp:8081 >/dev/null 2>&1; adb reverse tcp:4780 tcp:4780 >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done) & (sleep 2 && adb shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d exp://127.0.0.1:8081 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true) & expo start --localhost'
